words.sense: relating to energy of actual movement
misconceptions: Thinking a raised object must already be in motion.
Treating tension in a still object as movement.

words.sense: relating to energy stored by position, height, tension or condition
misconceptions: Assuming motion is the same as stored energy.

semantic_axes.description: Kinetic energy belongs to something currently moving, whereas potential energy is stored because of position or condition before movement.

edges.boundary_rule: Kinetic energy belongs to something currently moving, whereas potential energy is stored because of position or condition before movement.

misconceptions.M2: Assuming motion is the same as stored energy.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the energy of Jun's skateboard?

beats.text: Jun’s board rolls down the path; its moving wheels carry it past the bench.
beats.reason: The skateboard is actually moving is the evidence for kinetic.

beats.text: It reaches the top of a ramp and pauses for an instant, high above the path before rolling back.
beats.decisive_clue: it pauses while elevated above the path
beats.reason: At the paused high point, stored energy due to height is more relevant than motion.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: it pauses while elevated above the path.
chains.feedback_deep: At first, the skateboard’s rolling makes kinetic the best word. At the high turning point it is momentarily still, with energy stored through its elevated position, so potential is now better.
chains.contrast_rule: Kinetic is energy in motion; potential is energy in storage.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the energy of Mira's swing?

beats.text: Mira’s swing is momentarily still at the top of its arc, above its lowest resting position.
beats.decisive_clue: the swing is elevated and momentarily still
beats.reason: The swing is elevated and momentarily still is the evidence for potential.

beats.text: A moment later, the same swing sweeps through the lowest point, moving quickly past the ground.
beats.decisive_clue: the same swing is now moving quickly
beats.reason: At the lowest point, its current motion is decisive rather than its earlier height.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: the same swing is now moving quickly.
chains.feedback_deep: At the top, the still elevated swing has potential energy. As it moves rapidly through the bottom of the arc, kinetic energy is the clearer description of the energy in motion.
chains.contrast_rule: Kinetic is energy in motion; potential is energy in storage.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the energy of Yusuf's bicycle?

beats.text: Yusuf pedals across the courtyard, and the bicycle moves steadily beneath him.
beats.decisive_clue: the bicycle is travelling across the courtyard
beats.reason: The bicycle is travelling across the courtyard is the evidence for kinetic.

beats.text: Its tires spin even after he stops pushing the pedals for a moment.
beats.decisive_clue: spinning tires show motion continues without pedalling
beats.reason: The added detail confirms actual motion is present, which is the relevant condition.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: spinning tires show motion continues without pedalling.
chains.feedback_deep: Kinetic energy comes from motion, not from the source of the motion. Yusuf’s bicycle continues to move even when he briefly stops pedalling.
chains.contrast_rule: Kinetic is energy in motion; potential is energy in storage.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the energy of Elena's rubber band?

beats.text: Elena pulls a rubber band between two fingers and holds it motionless under tension.
beats.reason: The still band holds tension is the evidence for potential.

beats.text: It remains stretched while she waits to release one end.
beats.decisive_clue: the stretched band remains under tension without moving
beats.reason: Waiting does not turn stored tension into actual movement.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: the still band holds tension.
chains.feedback_deep: Potential energy may be stored in a stretched elastic object. Elena is holding it still; motion would begin when she lets it go.
chains.contrast_rule: Kinetic is energy in motion; potential is energy in storage.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the energy of Kofi's suitcase?

beats.text: Kofi lets the suitcase glide on its wheels along the station floor.
beats.reason: The suitcase is rolling now is the evidence for kinetic.

beats.text: The suitcase has a bright yellow strap around its handle.
beats.decisive_clue: its visible movement remains the deciding fact
beats.reason: Strap colour does not alter whether the suitcase is moving.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: the suitcase is rolling now.
chains.feedback_deep: Kinetic energy is present because of the suitcase’s motion. The bright strap is unrelated to the difference between moving energy and stored energy.
chains.contrast_rule: Kinetic is energy in motion; potential is energy in storage.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the energy of Ana's toy spring?

beats.text: Ana squeezes the toy spring into a short shape and holds it still between her hands.
beats.decisive_clue: the spring is compressed and held still
beats.reason: The spring is compressed and held still is the evidence for potential.

beats.text: She keeps the ends together so it cannot expand yet.
beats.decisive_clue: its compressed condition stores the ability to expand
beats.reason: Preventing expansion confirms the energy is stored in its deformation.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: its compressed condition stores the ability to expand.
chains.feedback_deep: Potential energy is stored by an object’s condition. Ana’s spring holds energy through compression; it is not currently springing outward.
chains.contrast_rule: Kinetic is energy in motion; potential is energy in storage.
